+/// Append-only campaign timeline, mirroring `plan-events.jsonl`.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
+pub struct CampaignEvent {
+    pub schema_version: u32,
+    pub ts: DateTime<Utc>,
+    pub kind: String,
+    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "serde_json::Value::is_null")]
+    pub detail: serde_json::Value,
+}
+
+pub fn campaign_events_path(plan_dir: &Path) -> PathBuf {
+    plan_dir.join(CAMPAIGN_EVENTS_FILE)
+}
+
+pub fn append_campaign_event(
+    plan_dir: &Path,
+    kind: impl Into<String>,
+    detail: serde_json::Value,
+) -> Result<()> {
+    let event = CampaignEvent {
+        schema_version: 1,
+        ts: Utc::now(),
+        kind: kind.into(),
+        detail,
+    };
+    crate::state::append_json_line(&campaign_events_path(plan_dir), &event)
+}
+
+pub fn read_campaign_events(plan_dir: &Path) -> Result<Vec<CampaignEvent>> {
+    let path = campaign_events_path(plan_dir);
+    match std::fs::read_to_string(&path) {
+        Ok(text) => text
+            .lines()
+            .filter(|line| !line.trim().is_empty())
+            .map(|line| {
+                serde_json::from_str(line).map_err(|source| DeadreckonError::Json {
+                    path: path.clone(),
+                    source,
+                })
+            })
+            .collect(),
+        Err(source) if source.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => Ok(Vec::new()),
+        Err(source) => Err(DeadreckonError::Io { path, source }),
+    }
+}

+/// Drive a campaign's sub-orchestrators sequentially, recording events and status
+/// transitions. Sequential (not concurrent like plan `fork`) is deliberate: the
+/// tree-budget ceiling (P5) must be checked *before* launching the next sub, which
+/// a concurrent batch cannot guarantee. The `launch` closure performs the actual
+/// spawn; tests inject a fake. A failed sub never aborts its siblings.
+#[allow(dead_code)] // wired by the campaign command in P9
+fn run_campaign_fork<F>(
+    campaign_dir: &Path,
+    campaign: &mut deadreckon_core::campaign::Campaign,
+    mut launch: F,
+) -> Result<()>
+where
+    F: FnMut(
+        &deadreckon_core::campaign::SubGoal,
+        &Path,
+    ) -> Result<deadreckon_core::campaign::SubResult>,
+{
+    use deadreckon_core::campaign::{
+        self, CampaignStatus, SubGoalStatus, append_campaign_event, write_campaign,
+    };
+
+    campaign.status = CampaignStatus::Forked;
+    campaign.forked_at = Some(chrono::Utc::now());
+    write_campaign(campaign_dir, campaign)?;
+    append_campaign_event(
+        campaign_dir,
+        "campaign_started",
+        serde_json::json!({ "n": campaign.n }),
+    )?;
+
+    for index in 0..campaign.sub_goals.len() {
+        let sub = campaign.sub_goals[index].clone();
+        let launch_dir = campaign_dir.join("launch").join(&sub.sub_id);
+        fs::create_dir_all(&launch_dir)?;
+        append_campaign_event(
+            campaign_dir,
+            "sub_launched",
+            serde_json::json!({ "sub_id": sub.sub_id }),
+        )?;
+        match launch(&sub, &launch_dir) {
+            Ok(result) => {
+                let target = &mut campaign.sub_goals[index];
+                target.sub_plan_id = result.plan_id.clone();
+                target.result_run_id = result.result_run_id.clone();
+                target.status = if result.ok {
+                    SubGoalStatus::Merged
+                } else {
+                    SubGoalStatus::Failed
+                };
+                append_campaign_event(
+                    campaign_dir,
+                    if result.ok {
+                        "sub_merged"
+                    } else {
+                        "sub_failed"
+                    },
+                    serde_json::json!({
+                        "sub_id": sub.sub_id,
+                        "plan_id": result.plan_id,
+                        "result_run_id": result.result_run_id,
+                    }),
+                )?;
+            }
+            Err(err) => {
+                campaign.sub_goals[index].status = SubGoalStatus::Failed;
+                append_campaign_event(
+                    campaign_dir,
+                    "sub_failed",
+                    serde_json::json!({ "sub_id": sub.sub_id, "reason": err.to_string() }),
+                )?;
+            }
+        }
+        campaign::write_campaign(campaign_dir, campaign)?;
+    }
+    Ok(())
+}

3	//! promoted run, and rolls every leaf's tamper-evident gate verdict up to the top.

78	/// Guard a requested campaign against the depth cap and ancestor cycles.
79	///
80	/// `current_depth` is the depth of the process requesting the campaign (0 for a
81	/// top-level invocation, 1 for a sub-orchestrator). The sub-orchestrators a
82	/// campaign launches sit at `current_depth + 1`; if that would reach
83	/// [`CAMPAIGN_MAX_DEPTH`] the campaign is refused. A requested sub-goal whose
84	/// `task_key` or resolved scope matches an ancestor's is refused as a cycle.
85	pub fn guard(
86	    current_depth: u32,
87	    ancestor_task_keys: &[String],
88	    ancestor_scopes: &[String],
89	    requested_sub_task_keys: &[String],
90	    requested_sub_scopes: &[String],
91	) -> Result<()> {
92	    if current_depth + 1 >= CAMPAIGN_MAX_DEPTH {
93	        return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
94	            "campaign refused: depth cap {CAMPAIGN_MAX_DEPTH} reached\n\
95	             try: run `orchestrate full-plan` (not campaign) inside a sub-orchestrator"
96	        )));
97	    }
98	    for key in requested_sub_task_keys {
99	        if ancestor_task_keys.iter().any(|ancestor| ancestor == key) {
100	            return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
101	                "campaign refused: sub-goal task_key '{key}' cycles to an ancestor\n\
102	                 try: reword the sub-goal so its task differs from an ancestor"
103	            )));
104	        }
105	    }
106	    for scope in requested_sub_scopes {
107	        if ancestor_scopes.iter().any(|ancestor| ancestor == scope) {
108	            return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
109	                "campaign refused: sub-goal scope '{scope}' cycles to an ancestor\n\
110	                 try: launch the campaign from a different checkout"
111	            )));
112	        }
113	    }
114	    Ok(())
115	}

228	/// Turn planner output (N sub-goal strings) into validated [`SubGoal`]s. Refuses a
229	/// count that does not match the request, an empty sub-goal, or a duplicate
230	/// (whitespace- and case-normalized).
231	pub fn build_sub_goals(goals: Vec<String>, requested_n: usize) -> Result<Vec<SubGoal>> {
232	    if goals.len() != requested_n {
233	        return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
234	            "campaign planner returned {} sub-goals; expected exactly {requested_n}",
235	            goals.len()
236	        )));
237	    }
238	    validate_task_count(goals.len())?;
239	    let mut seen = BTreeSet::new();
240	    let mut subs = Vec::with_capacity(goals.len());
241	    for (index, goal) in goals.into_iter().enumerate() {
242	        let trimmed = goal.trim();
243	        if trimmed.is_empty() {
244	            return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(
245	                "campaign sub-goal must not be empty".to_string(),
246	            ));
247	        }
248	        let normalized = trimmed
249	            .split_whitespace()
250	            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
251	            .join(" ")
252	            .to_ascii_lowercase();
253	        if !seen.insert(normalized) {
254	            return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
255	                "duplicate campaign sub-goal: {trimmed}"
256	            )));
257	        }
258	        subs.push(SubGoal {
259	            sub_id: format!("sub-{index}"),
260	            goal: trimmed.to_string(),
261	            task_key: crate::paths::task_key(trimmed),
262	            sub_plan_id: None,
263	            result_run_id: None,
264	            scope: None,
265	            status: SubGoalStatus::Pending,
266	        });
267	    }
268	    Ok(subs)
269	}

332	/// Build a [`Lineage`] from the campaign env-var values (any may be absent). This
333	/// is the pure core of reading lineage out of the process environment; absent
334	/// depth means depth 0 (a top-level invocation).
335	pub fn parse_lineage(
336	    depth: Option<&str>,
337	    campaign_root_id: Option<&str>,
338	    ancestor_task_keys: Option<&str>,
339	    ancestor_scopes: Option<&str>,
340	) -> Lineage {
341	    let split = |value: Option<&str>| -> Vec<String> {
342	        value
343	            .map(|raw| {
344	                raw.split(',')
345	                    .map(str::trim)
346	                    .filter(|item| !item.is_empty())
347	                    .map(ToString::to_string)
348	                    .collect()
349	            })
350	            .unwrap_or_default()
351	    };
352	    Lineage {
353	        schema_version: 1,
354	        depth: depth.and_then(|raw| raw.trim().parse().ok()).unwrap_or(0),
355	        campaign_root_id: campaign_root_id
356	            .map(str::trim)
357	            .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
358	            .map(ToString::to_string),
359	        ancestor_task_keys: split(ancestor_task_keys),
360	        ancestor_scopes: split(ancestor_scopes),
361	    }
362	}
363	
364	/// Read the campaign lineage from the current process environment.
365	pub fn lineage_from_env() -> Lineage {
366	    parse_lineage(
367	        std::env::var(ENV_DEPTH).ok().as_deref(),
368	        std::env::var(ENV_ROOT).ok().as_deref(),
369	        std::env::var(ENV_ANCESTOR_TASK_KEYS).ok().as_deref(),
370	        std::env::var(ENV_ANCESTOR_SCOPES).ok().as_deref(),
371	    )
372	}

383	    pub detail: serde_json::Value,

392	    kind: impl Into<String>,

394	) -> Result<()> {

404	pub fn read_campaign_events(plan_dir: &Path) -> Result<Vec<CampaignEvent>> {
405	    let path = campaign_events_path(plan_dir);
406	    match std::fs::read_to_string(&path) {
407	        Ok(text) => text
408	            .lines()
409	            .filter(|line| !line.trim().is_empty())
410	            .map(|line| {
411	                serde_json::from_str(line).map_err(|source| DeadreckonError::Json {
412	                    path: path.clone(),
413	                    source,
414	                })
415	            })
416	            .collect(),
417	        Err(source) if source.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => Ok(Vec::new()),
418	        Err(source) => Err(DeadreckonError::Io { path, source }),
419	    }
420	}

16235	/// Drive a campaign's sub-orchestrators sequentially, recording events and status
16236	/// transitions. Sequential (not concurrent like plan `fork`) is deliberate: the
16237	/// tree-budget ceiling (P5) must be checked *before* launching the next sub, which
16238	/// a concurrent batch cannot guarantee. The `launch` closure performs the actual
16239	/// spawn; tests inject a fake. A failed sub never aborts its siblings.
16240	#[allow(dead_code)] // wired by the campaign command in P9
16241	fn run_campaign_fork<F>(
16242	    campaign_dir: &Path,
16243	    campaign: &mut deadreckon_core::campaign::Campaign,
16244	    mut launch: F,
16245	) -> Result<()>
16246	where
16247	    F: FnMut(
16248	        &deadreckon_core::campaign::SubGoal,
16249	        &Path,
16250	    ) -> Result<deadreckon_core::campaign::SubResult>,

16252	    use deadreckon_core::campaign::{
16253	        self, CampaignStatus, SubGoalStatus, append_campaign_event, write_campaign,
16254	    };
16255	
16256	    campaign.status = CampaignStatus::Forked;
16257	    campaign.forked_at = Some(chrono::Utc::now());
16258	    write_campaign(campaign_dir, campaign)?;
16259	    append_campaign_event(
16260	        campaign_dir,
16261	        "campaign_started",
16262	        serde_json::json!({ "n": campaign.n }),
16263	    )?;
16264	
16265	    for index in 0..campaign.sub_goals.len() {
16266	        let sub = campaign.sub_goals[index].clone();
16267	        let launch_dir = campaign_dir.join("launch").join(&sub.sub_id);
16268	        fs::create_dir_all(&launch_dir)?;
16269	        append_campaign_event(
16270	            campaign_dir,
16271	            "sub_launched",
16272	            serde_json::json!({ "sub_id": sub.sub_id }),
16273	        )?;
16274	        match launch(&sub, &launch_dir) {
16275	            Ok(result) => {
16276	                let target = &mut campaign.sub_goals[index];
16277	                target.sub_plan_id = result.plan_id.clone();
16278	                target.result_run_id = result.result_run_id.clone();
16279	                target.status = if result.ok {
16280	                    SubGoalStatus::Merged
16281	                } else {
16282	                    SubGoalStatus::Failed
16283	                };
16284	                append_campaign_event(
16285	                    campaign_dir,
16286	                    if result.ok {
16287	                        "sub_merged"
16288	                    } else {
16289	                        "sub_failed"
16290	                    },
16291	                    serde_json::json!({
16292	                        "sub_id": sub.sub_id,
16293	                        "plan_id": result.plan_id,
16294	                        "result_run_id": result.result_run_id,
16295	                    }),
16296	                )?;
16297	            }
16298	            Err(err) => {
16299	                campaign.sub_goals[index].status = SubGoalStatus::Failed;
16300	                append_campaign_event(

16302	                    "sub_failed",
16303	                    serde_json::json!({ "sub_id": sub.sub_id, "reason": err.to_string() }),
16304	                )?;
16305	            }
16306	        }
16307	        campaign::write_campaign(campaign_dir, campaign)?;
16308	    }
